planBanner.noneBody: Choose a plan to keep adding members and storing files.
planBanner.endedBody: Choose a plan to keep everything working for your members.
planBanner.pastDue: Payment for your {plan} plan is overdue.
planBanner.pastDueBody: Pay or switch plans before access is limited.
planBanner.pending: Your payment for {plan} is waiting for approval.
planBanner.pendingBody: The plan starts as soon as the payment is confirmed.
planBanner.cancelled: Your {plan} plan was cancelled and ends on {date}.
planBanner.renewBody: Renew or choose another plan so nothing stops.
planBanner.trialBody: Choose a plan to keep using everything after the trial.
planBanner.readOnly: Your {plan} plan has lapsed: your organization is read-only.
planBanner.readOnlyBody: Everyone can still sign in, view, copy and export. Choose a plan to make changes again.
planBanner.grace: Payment for your {plan} plan is overdue. Changes stop on {date}.
planBanner.graceBody: Everything keeps working until then. After that your organization is read-only until you pay.
